summary: Frontend-only test of optional image editing + Save/Open/Delete work (IndexedDB v2). All requested features pass. Upload (single + multi) does not open editor, image used as-is (800x1100 stays 800x1100, no enhance). 'Modifica' button opens editor; Fine closes and applies (trim 800x1100->704x1004). Save button disabled with no images, prompt default 'Lavoro 29/10/26, 09:41', toast + work-1 entry with thumbnail, name, '3 immagini · A3', date. After page.reload, work persisted; Open restored A3 landscape, margin 1.7, gap 0.3, duplex, 3 items with front/back images (same px sizes), sizes 9x2.5 (tag)/7x5/9.5x13.5, copies 3, round+contain, tag switch + back tag text – zero diffs vs. pre-save state. Delete asks confirm and shows works-empty. Templates (section 4) save/persist/use still work. PDF export downloaded stampa_A3_oriz.pdf. Default item size 9.5x13.5 confirmed.

design_issues.screen: Item card with Fronte/Retro (duplex, 2 dropzones side by side)
issues: The pink 'Modifica' button + replace/remove buttons overlap the FRONTE/RETRO badge in the top-left (badge truncated to 'FRO'/'RET'). Consider icon-only Modifica in narrow boxes or moving the action buttons to the bottom.

action_items: Minor: fix overlap of Modifica button with FRONTE/RETRO badge in duplex layout
Minor: wrap onSaveWork/onOpenWork in try/catch and toast.error on IndexedDB failure (e.g., quota exceeded with many large images)
critical_code_review_comments: onSaveWork/onOpenWork have no error handling; an IndexedDB rejection (quota) leaves the user without feedback
Console warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' comes from visual-edit tooling injection in ExportBar dpi select, not app code
IndexedDB v1->v2 upgrade logic uses objectStoreNames.contains checks - safe; verified only via code review (test contexts start fresh)
seed_data_creation: None persisted (browser contexts are ephemeral; test work deleted)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser automation contexts are fresh each call, so save+reload+open must be done in one script. Use page.on('dialog') to accept prompt/confirm. Work testids: work-{id}, work-{id}-open, work-{id}-delete, works-empty, save-work-btn. Test images created in /tmp/imgs (a.jpg 800x1100, b.jpg 1000x700, c.jpg 600x600) via PIL.
